      Review window: Aug 3, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026

         **Review examples:**

            2. _Linnea Martell_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "they charged me for subscription I already cancelled and I can't even talk to an actual person just AI I want my money back and I don't even use the app or have it...."
